artworks.title: Illustration to Jean Desmarets' "L'Ariane"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in front of a classical building in an outdoor setting. The architecture features columns and is reminiscent of Roman or Greek styles. The figures are wearing historical clothing and are engaged in an activity by the steps of the building. One figure is on bended knee, while others stand or gather around, some holding staffs or other objects. The use of shading and line work creates depth and texture throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Illustration to Jean Desmarets' "L'Ariane"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: This is an image of a dungeon scene. In the drawing, there is a shadowy, arched stone dungeon with a figure seated against a stone structure and another figure standing nearby holding a torch. In the background, there is a second arched alcove with steps leading upwards, and another distant figure holding an object. The details of the stonework and the play with shadows and light contribute to the somber and tense atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Illustration to Jean Desmarets' "L'Ariane"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with multiple figures under a tree in the foreground observing a dynamic battle scene unfolding in the background. The background features mounted soldiers engaged in action, with billowing clouds and smoke adding to the chaotic atmosphere. The artwork showcases detailed line work, emphasizing expressive faces and turbulent clouds, with elements like trees and the direction of the figures' gaze guiding the viewer's eye.

artworks.title: Illustration to Jean Desmarets' "L'Ariane"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battlefield scene. The image depicts combat with a central figure wielding a sword over a fallen opponent, showing a moment of action. The foreground shows multiple figures in armor engaged in close combat, with a horse featured to the left. The background shows a battlefield with banners and distant figures suggesting a larger ongoing battle. The drawing captures movement through dynamic poses and details armor and landscape elements.

artworks.title: Illustration to Jean Desmarets' "L'Ariane"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: This is a monochrome drawing of a forest scene where a figure in flowing garments stands over two others lying on the ground. The standing figure wields a bow and reaches for arrows. The background features dense foliage and distant figures observing the scene. Fine lines and shading detail the trees, garments, and landscape, enhancing the drama of the scene.

artworks.title: Illustration to Jean Desmarets' "L'Ariane"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient sacrificial ritual. The scene depicts an elevated platform where a central male figure with a long beard, wearing an ornate hat, holds a knife over another figure who is restrained and hunched forward. To the left, a woman is poised dramatically with one hand raised. Behind them, a crowd of onlookers and more individuals in the foreground suggest an audience witnessing the ritual. The background reveals classical architecture like temples and an obelisk. The drawing is intricately rendered with careful attention to details, such as the expressions on the faces of the figures and the textures of the garments they wear.

artworks.title: Illustration to Jean Desmarets' "L'Ariane"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession scene. The artwork depicts various figures in a grand procession, including some riding in an ornate chariot drawn by horses and others on foot. Central to the composition is a character wearing a crown. The background shows an elaborate architectural structure with classical elements and a horizon filled with figures with plumes, spears, and standards. There is a sense of movement generated by the parade of figures and animals moving towards the foreground. The lines are finely detailed, emphasizing the rich texture of the scene and adding depth to the architecture and costumes. The presence of various figures and ornamental details gives this work a narrative depth.

artworks.title: Baigneuse aux oies (Bathers with Geese)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on light green dyed paper
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring swans in a body of water surrounded by dense foliage. The image depicts a tranquil moment in nature with swans positioned in the water. The surrounding area is filled with trees and bushes, creating a canopy that frames the water. Light filters through the canopy, casting light areas on the water and darker tones in the landscape. The use of light and shadow suggests depth, while scratches and hatching technique add texture. This painting is in the style of Georges Seurat.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman Looking Back Over Her Shoulder
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed drawing of a person's head and shoulders. The individual is shown in a three-quarter view with their head slightly tilted back and turned to the side, looking upward. The person has facial features with a smooth complexion, prominent cheekbones, and an attentive expression. They have light, wavy hair tied into a bun, revealing fine, soft strands. The individual wears a garment draped over their shoulders, indicated by soft lines suggesting fabric folds. The background is plain with a simple border around the sketch, highlighting the person's profile and expression.

artworks.title: Studies of Horses [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink on laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses. It features five individual sketches of horses in different poses and angles, all rendered in a delicate fine-line style with brown ink on paper. Three sketches depict horses in dynamic postures emphasizing their muscular build and movement. Additionally, there is a partial drawing focusing on a horse's head and another on its hindquarters. The details highlight the mane, tail, and anatomical structure of the horses. The sketches are placed within a faintly bordered rectangle.

artworks.title: Studies of Horses [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a collection of line sketches featuring horses and abstract forms. The sketches show horses in motion, different angles, and poses, using confident lines and curves. The drawing suggests a study with variation in styles, exploring equine forms. It has a border, indicating it may be a page from a sketchbook or a deliberate collection of studies.

artworks.title: Moses with the Tablets of Law
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut (black line block and two brown tone blocks)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated elderly figure, depicted from the lower legs upward, including their head and upper body. The person is positioned with one knee raised and the other foot slightly tucked beneath, leaning slightly back against a rock or tree. They have a long, flowing beard and thick, wavy hair with two short projections at the top. The individual wears a long robe with drapery and holds a staff in their left hand, while their right hand rests on large tablets. The background features trees and rocky outcroppings, and the image is in sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Genius of Castiglione
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a complex allegorical scene. The central figure appears to be carved from stone with flowing hair and a headpiece resembling feathers or leaves. A cherubic figure with wings holds a small trumpet nearby. Various items like a basket and a scroll are scattered on the ground. The line work creates rich texture and intricate detail, defining the leaves, fabric, and mythical figures in the drawing.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Il Solimano"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20 x 14 cm (7 7/8 x 5 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately dressed figure standing between two columns with shields and weapons at its base. The figure is adorned in a robe with decorative headgear and holds a staff, carrying a shield that contains text. It stands before a backdrop of a dramatic sky with clouds and a coat of arms or emblem above. The columns are similarly elaborate, topped with shield-like decorations and surrounded by assorted objects that suggest themes of war or valor, including arrows, swords, and drums. The etching captures intricate details with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act I
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21 × 28.6 cm (8 1/4 × 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape from an elevated viewpoint, looking down a wide street with grand architectural buildings on both sides. The horizon is in the middle third of the image, and a large ornate structure with arches is visible in the distance. The style is detailed, resembling etchings with fine lines and cross-hatching used to depict intricate architectural details and figures creating depth and activity. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and brown, giving an antique feel. Close to us, there are groups of well-dressed people gathered, suggesting a procession or gathering. More figures are dispersed down the street, appearing to be moving towards the distance, contributing to the lively atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act II
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.3 × 28.4 cm (8 × 11 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective view looking down an urban street towards a grand, arched structure in the distance. The street is lined with elaborate buildings featuring classical detailing, statues, and people in robes and headpieces walking in a procession. The color palette consists of varying shades of grey and beige, typical of etching techniques, emphasizing detailed line work and crosshatching for shadow and depth.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act III
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.5 × 28.5 cm (8 1/16 × 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: The image displays an architectural scene with a perspective view down an urban block. The viewpoint is from street level, looking down a wide avenue bordered by tall, elaborately designed buildings on either side, showcasing classical architectural elements. The horizon is high in the image, featuring diminishing details of buildings and an architectural structure resembling an arched gateway or colonnade in the distance. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic, sepia-toned palette, giving it an antique feel. The artwork shows finely detailed brushstrokes or etching technique, highlighting textures and forms of the architectural elements. Figures in period costumes are depicted in groups, creating a sense of procession or a public event, guiding the viewer's eye towards the distant architectural features that fade into the background.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act IV
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.6 × 28.6 cm (8 1/2 × 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban or architectural scene from a central and symmetrical point of view. A street is surrounded by grand buildings with intricate architectural details such as columns, statues in niches, and patterned stonework. People in various flowing garments populate the scene. The drawing style suggests an etching or engraving, using fine lines and crosshatching for texture, depth, and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown or sepia. The sky above shows delicate lines indicating clouds.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act V
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic and fiery scene in a city during a conflict. The artwork depicts buildings engulfed in flames, with dense clouds of smoke billowing up into the sky. In the foreground and throughout the street, groups of figures are engaged in frantic activity. The architecture of the buildings reflects an ornate and baroque style. The drawing includes intricate details like the dynamic motion of the figures and the stylized depiction of smoke and fire, contributing to the tension and urgency of the scene.

artworks.title: Seated Man Flanked by Two Reclining Figures; Huddle of Figures in Lower Left Corner
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows simple, sketch-like lines forming abstract human figure shapes. One figure is sitting with legs bent, while others are lying on a surface. The drawing suggests a bench or platform, with the figures arranged casually. Faint lines in the background hint at more people, completing the abstract gathering scene.

artworks.title: Three Sketches of a Standing Woman
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body sketches of a person in different poses. The left figure appears light and holds a tray with one hand while the other hand rests by the side, with the head tilted downwards. In the center, the outline is more distinct, displaying a person in profile with hands in pockets and long straight hair. The figure on the right is seen from behind with similar long hair and arms positioned with a slight bend at the elbows. All figures wear ankle-length dresses. The background is plain and serves as a surface for the sketches.

artworks.title: Le gueux des campagnes
artworks.medium: woodcut on Japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joan Lees in memory of Edward Lees, M.D.
artworks.description: The image shows a person crouching down and holding a long staff. They have a rugged appearance with facial hair, wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat and practical clothing. In the background, there are dense foliage, rustic buildings, and an open landscape under a clear sky.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Agreable diversite de figures"
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental page with calligraphic text and decorative elements. The drawing features a central coat of arms flanked by two symmetrical, elaborate plumes or scroll-like decorations that curl outward. Below the coat of arms, there is elegant, calligraphic text arranged in a flowing script. The border and decorations suggest a formality and richness typical of historical documents. The coat of arms is detailed with horizontal stripes and a crown-like design at the top.

artworks.title: Place Dauphine
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from an elevated perspective showing two large symmetrical buildings framing a central statue on a raised pedestal. The horizon is high, separating the sky from the urban landscape with various figures. Additional buildings and a cityscape are faintly visible at the horizon. The etching technique is used with detailed textures and shading. The color palette is monochromatic with variations of ink. Many small figures are present near us, engaging in different activities. The area around the statue is bustling with more activity, creating a sense of movement and interaction.
